Pathways #22 – Free Pathfinder RPG Magazine by Rite Publishing

Vendor: Rite Publishing
Type: Book

Pathways #22 is a free digital magazine from Rite Publishing packed with Open Game Content for Pathfinder 1e — professionally crafted material from RPG industry veterans, ready to drop straight into your campaign.

Who This Appeals To

Perfect for Pathfinder 1e GMs and players who want a steady stream of free, quality content. Whether you're looking for new character options, monster templates, or expert reviews to guide your next purchase, Pathways delivers.

Features
30 Badges of Faith by Mike Welham – new divine character options
Monster Templates from 101 Not So Simple Monster Templates by Steven D. Russell
Raging Swan Press content by Creighton Broadhurst
Adventureaweek.com articles by Will Myers
Product reviews by Endzeitgeist
Exclusive interview with Daron Woodson of Abandoned Arts
Completely free – no cost to download
What You'll Experience

A curated collection of Pathfinder content from some of the hobby's most respected creators — all in one free download. Pathways is consistently one of the best free resources available for Pathfinder 1e players and GMs.

Pathways #14 – Free Pathfinder RPG Zine with Templates, Feats & Archetypes

Vendor: Rite Publishing
Type: Book
Price: 0.00

Pathways #14 is a free digital zine for the Pathfinder Roleplaying Game, packed with Open Game Content ready to drop straight into your campaign. A bloody path stretches out before you — and Rite Publishing is here to make sure it’s worth every step.

If you’re a Pathfinder GM or player hungry for fresh mechanical content without the price tag, this one delivers. New templates by Steven D. Russell (101 Not So Simple Templates), tactical archetypes from Will McArdell and Benjamin Rombeaut, feats and encounters by Creighton Broadhurst of Raging Swan Press, domain content from Thomas LeBlanc and David Paul, top product reviews by Endzeitgeist, and an in-depth interview with Steven D. Russell on designing 1001 Spells. A full table’s worth of material in a single free download.

In The Company of Dragons Playtest – Free Dragon PC Preview for Pathfinder 1e

Vendor: Rite Publishing
Type: Book
Price: 0.00

Who This Appeals To

Pathfinder 1e players who have always wanted to play an actual dragon — not a humanoid with dragon features, but a true wyrm growing in power from wyrmling to ancient. This free playtest is perfect for groups looking to try something genuinely different before committing to the full product.

Features
Free playtest rules for dragon player characters in Pathfinder 1e
Full dragon progression from wyrmling to ancient — a complete racial class system
Unique dragon abilities and powers at each stage of growth
Preview of the full product’s mechanics and design philosophy
Opportunity to provide feedback that shaped the final release
What You'll Experience

This playtest gives you a genuine taste of what it’s like to play a dragon in Pathfinder — authentically powerful, balanced for group play, and unlike anything else in the system. Download it free, bring it to your table, and see why the full In The Company of Dragons became a fan favorite.

Common Questions

Is this really free? Yes — no cost, no catch. It’s a complete playtest preview.

What’s different in the full version? The complete product includes expanded dragon types, additional abilities, and the polished final ruleset.

Rite Map Pack: Coastal Region

Vendor: Rite Publishing
Type: Book
Price: 5.99

Rite Map Pack: Coastal Region
"I wisely started with a map and made the story fit.."

Coastal Region, a new offering from Tommi Salama the gifted cartographer for Kobold Press, Rite Publishing, Raging Swan Press and many more, gives you a new region to use in any campaign! This elegant, coastal regin is a spoiler-free unlabeled versions, created in hand drawn gorgeous full-color, This file includes a JPEG plus a printable map pack in Letter pages so you can lay it across the table.

In the Company of Vampires (PFRPG)

Vendor: Rite Publishing
Type: Book
Price: 5.99

The Blood Changes Everything

In the Company of Vampiresintroduces moroi culture, providing a unique new undead race with versatile customization options representing vampiric families and curses. Do you choose the divine inspired, the bestial nightcallers, the disturbing nosferatu, the fey-touched shades, the masterful sovereigns, the stoic vanguards, the magic-wielding warlocks, or some combination? This book also includes:

Alternate racial traits, including mingled lineages and humanoid racial trait options.
The blood noble paragon class, with more than 80 unique talents to drive your undead evolution.
Make any class vampiric with the blood bastard and cambion archetypes!
Favored classes, racial feats, and new spells.
Optional hunting rules, a revised vampire template, and advice for running games for vampires!

From the masterminds that brought you Dragons, Aberrations, and Doppelgangers, we present you with In the Company of Vampires.
